I added `from __future__ import annotations` to all 20 carrier modules in `shop/carriers/` (acme through tundra). `__init__.py` wasn't touched, and nothing else changed: the diff is 20 lines added, none removed.

Each module starts with a TODO comment and then a one-line docstring, so the import goes right after the docstring, before `import re`. Python requires a `from __future__` import to come after the docstring, so this is the earliest place it can go. None of the modules already had a `__future__` import.

**Tests:** `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 6 tests and all passed. I couldn't use pytest: there's no `python` command on this machine and pytest isn't installed for `python3`, and I didn't install anything.

Nothing has been committed.
